title: Task Schema
description: Validates a single atomic task object within Execution_Plan.json.

task_id.description: Unique task identifier in TASK-NNN format.

title.description: Concise task title. Must describe exactly one action in ≤ 8 words.

description.description: Detailed description of what this task does, why, and any relevant constraints.

context_summary.description: Optional context summary for L-complexity tasks. Max 200 words. Helps dev agent load relevant context.

type.description: Task type classifying which layer of the stack this task belongs to.

layer.description: Architectural layer this task belongs to.

file_path.description: Exact relative path to the file this task creates or modifies. Required for all tasks.

function_signatures.description: Pre-specified function signatures for the dev agent. Reduces ambiguity and context overhead.

examples: export async function createTask(input: CreateTaskInput): Promise<Task>
export default async function TaskListPage(): Promise<JSX.Element>

depends_on.description: Array of task IDs this task depends on. Must be declared explicitly — no implicit dependencies.

acceptance_criteria.description: Testable acceptance criteria for this task. Minimum 1 required.

unit_required.description: Whether unit tests are required for this task.

e2e_flow_description.description: Description of the E2E user flow to test.

test_data_requirements.description: Test data or fixtures required for this task's tests.

mock_requirements.description: List of things that need to be mocked in tests.

test_notes.description: Additional notes for the dev agent about testing this task.

auth_required.description: Whether authentication is required to invoke this code path.

input_validation_required.description: Whether Zod input validation is required. True for any task touching user input.

zod_schema_name.description: Name of the Zod schema to use for validation.

audit_log_required.description: Whether an audit_log entry must be written. True for any sensitive data mutation.

sql_injection_risk.description: Whether this task has SQL injection risk (e.g., dynamic queries).

xss_risk.description: Whether this task has XSS risk (e.g., rendering user-supplied HTML).

csrf_risk.description: Whether this task has CSRF risk (e.g., state-changing endpoints without protection).

cron_guard_required.description: Whether guardCron() must be the first call. True for all cron handler tasks.

devsecops_review_required.description: Whether this task requires DevSecOps review before implementation.

security_notes.description: Additional security guidance for the dev agent.

estimated_complexity.description: Estimated implementation complexity. XL tasks are blocked.

blocking_reason.description: If status is blocked, the reason why.
